Answer: D
Reason: The arrow in Figure 2 points to a distinct, well-circumscribed, and lobulated opacity located in the anterior aspect of the right lower lung zone. This specific morphological description (well-circumscribed, lobulated) matches option D and is characteristic of a pulmonary nodule that could represent a primary lung carcinoma metastasizing to the breast/chest wall, distinguishing it from diffuse or spiculated primary breast lesions.
